review_text: Absolutely thrilling from start to finish. Stellar Run is the best action film this year!
Incredible pacing and stunning visuals. Stellar Run exceeded all expectations.
A must-watch. Great performances, amazing action sequences in Stellar Run.
Stellar Run is a masterpiece. Cannot stop thinking about it.

Good sci-fi movie, Dark Orbit kept me engaged throughout.
Dark Orbit delivers on its premise with a satisfying ending.
Last Kingdom is emotionally powerful and beautifully shot.
One of the best dramas I've seen. Last Kingdom deserves all the praise.
Last Kingdom is a gripping historical epic with outstanding acting.

Solid thriller. Neon Mirage kept me guessing until the end.

Best movie of the year! Hollow Earth is pure cinematic perfection.
Hollow Earth is a visual feast with a compelling narrative.
